disabled.description: Disable editing, sequential focus and form participation.

error-text.description: Message for a failing code constraint. Omit to use the browser's message.

help-text.description: Instructions saying where the code was sent and how long it is valid.

label.description: Visible accessible name. Supply a label in the language of the form.

length.description: Number of cells and maximum code length. Unsupported lengths fall back to six.

name.description: Key for the single value submitted to the enclosing form.

required.description: Require a complete code before submitting. An optional field may be empty.

size.description: Medium or small cells. The form region's density adjusts both sizes.

type.description: Allowed characters and keyboard hint. Alphanumeric mode preserves ASCII letter case.

value.description:
The current code, including leading zeros. Use the attribute to declare
the reset value. Programmatic assignments are normalized and silent.

--ki-code-input-active-border.description: Focus outline around the active or selected cells.

--ki-code-input-backdrop-filter.description: Optional compositing filter behind a code cell.

--ki-code-input-bg-image.description: Optional image painted over the code cell fill.

--ki-code-input-blink-duration.description: Duration of one code caret blink.

--ki-code-input-cell-size.description: Default code cell edge before applying control density.

--ki-code-input-cell-size-sm.description: Small code cell edge before applying control density.

--ki-code-input-disabled-fg.description: Code character ink while the field is disabled.

--ki-code-input-error-border.description: Code cell boundary after failed validation.

--ki-code-input-selection-bg.description: Background of a selected code character.

--ki-code-input-selection-fg.description: Ink of a selected code character.

--ki-code-input-touch-font-size.description: Minimum native input text size on a coarse pointer.

--ki-control-border-width.description: Stroke width of the boundary of a compact control.

--ki-density-control-offset.description: Added to the block size of every scaled control and row (button, icon button, field, select, textarea, option, list item, tab). Components floor the result at ki.size.target-min.

--ki-density-target-min.description: The smallest pointer target any density may produce: 24 x 24 CSS px by default and in compact (WCAG 2.5.8 AA), 44 x 44 in touch (WCAG 2.5.5). It floors a shrinking control but never lifts what a control paints: a control painted smaller extends its target to it, invisibly; rows and tabs grow to it (spec 045 A1).

--ki-focus-ring-width.description: Thickness of the keyboard focus ring every focusable component draws (its outline). One token instead of one per component, so a mode or a theme changes every ring at once.

--ki-layout-spacing-xs.description: The xs spacing step for a stack or grid gap.

--ki-text-danger-high-em.description: semantic color for text danger high em.

--ki-text-high-em.description: semantic color for text high em.

--ki-text-supporting.description: Supporting text of an enabled control: field labels, placeholders, list secondary lines, quiet button labels and unselected tabs. A role, distinct from the med-em emphasis step it resolves to, so a mode can strengthen enabled supporting text without touching the disabled ink that also draws from med-em (directly, or through text.muted).

--ki-typography-family-body.description: semantic font family for typography family body.

--ki-typography-family-mono.description: semantic font family for typography family mono.

--ki-typography-line-height-body-1.description: semantic dimension for typography line height body 1.

--ki-typography-line-height-caption-2.description: semantic dimension for typography line height caption 2.

--ki-typography-size-body-1.description: semantic dimension for typography size body 1.

--ki-typography-size-caption-2.description: semantic dimension for typography size caption 2.

--ki-typography-weight-body-medium.description: semantic font weight for typography weight body medium.

--ki-typography-weight-body-normal.description: semantic font weight for typography weight body normal.

--ki-typography-weight-body-semibold.description: semantic font weight for typography weight body semibold.

component.description: A form-associated verification field with one native text input and a visual box per character.

ki-complete.description: Emitted after the input event when the edited code fills all the cells.

ki-input.description: Emitted when a user edit changes the code.

cell.description: Decorative box for one code character.

error.description: Polite validation message that replaces the instructions.

field.description: Enclosure of the native input and its visual boxes.

help.description: Delivery and validity instructions read with the field.

input.description: Single native text input, responsible for editing and autofill.

label.description: Visible label supplying the native input's accessible name.
